name: Haruo Sotozaki

films.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train
films.overview: Tanjiro Kamado, joined with Inosuke Hashibira, a boy raised by boars who wears a boar's head, and Zenitsu Agatsuma, a scared boy who reveals his true power when he sleeps, boards the Infinity Train on a new mission with the Fire Hashira, Kyojuro Rengoku, to defeat a demon who has been tormenting the people and killing the demon slayers who oppose it!

Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Sibling's Bond
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hashira Meeting Arc
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba -To the Hashira Training-
films.overview: Tanjiro undergoes rigorous training with the Stone Hashira, Himejima, in his quest to become a Hashira. Meanwhile, Muzan continues to search for Nezuko and Ubuyashiki. A recap of Kimetsu no Yaiba episodes 55–56, with new footage and special end credits.

films.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Asakusa Arc
films.overview: Tanjiro ventures to Asakusa for his second mission with the Demon Slayer Corps. A recap of Kimetsu no Yaiba episodes 6–10, with new footage and special end credits.

films.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Tsuzumi Mansion Arc
films.overview: Tanjiro ventures to the south-southeast where he encounters a cowardly young man named Zenitsu Agatsuma, a fellow survivor from Final Selection. His sparrow asks Tanjiro to help keep him in line. A recap of Kimetsu no Yaiba episodes 11–14, with new footage and special end credits.

films.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba -To the Swordsmith Village-
films.overview: A recap of Kimetsu no Yaiba episodes 43–45, with new footage and special end credits. Together with his comrades, Zenitsu and Inosuke, along with one of the top-ranking members of the Demon Slayer Corps, Tengen Uzui, Tanjiro embarks on a mission within the Entertainment District, where they encounter the formidable, high-ranking demons, Daki and Gyutaro.

films.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
films.overview: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro, Nezuko, and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.
